title: TPT Primitives canonical types
description: Payload schemas for the canonical objects of tpt-primitives. On the wire each payload is wrapped in the schema-version envelope ["tpt-canonical", version, payload] (see docs/decisions/0001-canonical-encoding-and-identity.md).

PrimitiveValue.description: A scalar value allowed in canonical content.
PrimitiveValue.title: PrimitiveValue

ResourceSet.description:
A deterministic set of resource amounts. `BTreeMap` keeps canonical
order sorted regardless of construction order (ADR 0001).
ResourceSet.title: ResourceSet

ResourceKind.description:
A kind of resource. Known kinds get canonical names; ecosystems may
add `Custom` kinds with their own labels.

oneOf.description: An ecosystem-defined kind; the label carries the unit convention.

ResourceKind.title: ResourceKind

EnvironmentSpec.title: EnvironmentSpec

Grant.description:
A single authorized action on a resource (spec §5). Capabilities carry
a set of grants; attenuation shrinks the set.

action.description: The action authorized on the resource (opaque, ecosystem-defined).

Grant.title: Grant

AuthorityDomain.description:
An authority domain (spec §5): the namespace a capability is bound to.
Non-empty opaque label.

Principal.description:
A principal (holder) of authority. Non-empty opaque label; the
ecosystem maps principals to concrete actors at its boundary.

Lease.description:
A lease: temporal authority over a domain (spec §6). Valid on
`[valid_from, expires_at)` in logical time (ADR 0002).

expires_at.description: First logical tick at which the lease has expired (exclusive).

holder.description: Principal the lease was issued to.

valid_from.description: First logical tick at which the lease is valid (inclusive).

Lease.title: Lease

AuthorityDomain.description:
An authority domain (spec §5): the namespace a capability is bound to.
Non-empty opaque label.

Epoch.description: An epoch of a domain: a monotone invalidation counter (spec §6).

counter.description: Monotone counter; a transition increments it.

Epoch.title: Epoch

AuthorityDomain.description:

EpochRequirement.description:
Requirement that the *current* epoch of `domain` still be `epoch`.
After a transition the requirement can no longer be satisfied.

epoch.description: The epoch the capability remains valid in.

Operation.description:

canonical parameters. Kept open (rather than a closed enum) so
ecosystems can register operation kinds without forking the type;
parameters are `PrimitiveMap`s, so they stay deterministic.

Execution.description:
One realisation of a computation (spec §11).

`attempt` and `started_at` (plus the world) ensure that two runs of
the same computation are distinct executions with distinct identities.

attempt.description: 1-based attempt number for this computation in this world.

finished_at.description: Logical tick the execution ended, once known.

outcome.description: How the execution ended, once known.

trace.description: The trace of the execution, once recorded.

world.description: The canonical execution world (spec §16) the computation ran in.

Execution.title: Execution

identity is stable across normalization and replay.

causal_parents.description: Events this one is causally downstream of.

EvidenceKind.description:
The typed evidence kinds (spec §13). Each carries its own
ecosystem-relevant metadata; result strength is mapped through
[`AssuranceLevel`].

oneOf.description: A formal proof, discharged by an external proof kernel.

kernel.description: The external kernel trusted to have checked it (spec §19).

oneOf.description: A model-checking run against a named model.
A conformance run against a named suite.
A deterministic simulation run in a canonical execution world.

world.description: The world the simulation ran in.

oneOf.description: A differential check against a baseline implementation.
A benchmark measurement (fixed-point: value plus unit).

scale.description: Power of ten the value was scaled by.

value.description: Measured value, scaled by `scale` to stay integral (ADR 0001).
